# COMPAT gaps: every approximated or refused directive the importers report.
#
# <source> <directive> <priority> <status> <reason>
#
# status:
#   workaround  the gap is covered by another ExyonQ surface; the operator keeps
#               the behaviour after the documented edit
#   open        no equivalent yet. An `open` line with priority P1 or P2 fails
#               scripts/gates/compat-matrices-gate.sh, which is how "0 brechas
#               abiertas P1/P2" stays a measurement instead of a claim.
#
# A line is required for every lossy *and* every refused entry the importers
# report; the gate measures the reports, not this file.
#
# --- nginx: lossy entries (13 measured on 2026-11-16) ---------------------
# `listen`, `ssl_certificate`, `ssl_certificate_key` and `return` are exact as of
# 2026-11-16: the certificate pair is mapped to [server.tls], the `ssl` listen
# flag is served by it, and `return <status> "<body>"` maps to `route.respond`,
# served by the literal-response handler. A `return` body with `$` variables
# stays lossy on purpose (an IR literal body is not interpolated).
nginx    expires                P3  workaround  expires N maps to cache_headers.by_mime."*" max_age for static responses (ADR-061); `expires off` and negative values have no IR form, so leave them out and let the runtime default apply
nginx    index                  P3  workaround  Only the first filename reaches route.index (the runtime resolves one index, crates/exyonq-mod-static/src/root.rs); list the primary index first or add an explicit route for the others
nginx    location               P2  workaround  NGINX `~`/`~*` regex locations can intercept a prefix match and `^~` orders prefixes; ExyonQ matches prefix/suffix/exact in a fixed order, so declare the same set as explicit routes (match.prefix / match.suffix / match.exact) and keep the intended precedence — a bare migrated prefix route alone can answer a URI nginx would have sent to the regex block
nginx    try_files              P3  workaround  Variable forms ($uri/$uri/.../$query_string) and terminal `=404` are carried as front_controller or the default 404; a `=NNN` terminal that is not 404 has no IR action

# --- nginx: refused entries (5 measured on 2026-11-16) --------------------
nginx    add_header             P3  workaround  Cache-Control is carried by [cache]/expires; the runtime rewrites those headers itself (ADR-062 denylist)
nginx    client_max_body_size   P3  workaround  The request body cap lives in the route body budget, not in a server-level nginx knob
nginx    proxy_set_header       P3  workaround  Upgrade/Connection are hop-by-hop and owned by the runtime (ADR-051)
nginx    keepalive              P3  workaround  Upstream connection reuse comes from the IR pool policy, not the nginx directive

# --- apache ---------------------------------------------------------------
apache   DirectoryIndex         P3  workaround  The runtime resolves a single index (crates/exyonq-mod-static/src/root.rs); the importer sets route.index to the first filename, so list the primary index first — the remaining filenames are NOT served by generic static resolution
